description: This file defines a custom awaitable class 'SocketAwaitableEventArgs' that extends 'SocketAsyncEventArgs' to facilitate asynchronous socket operations with support for Task-based programming models, including custom continuation scheduling.

classes.name: SocketAwaitableEventArgs
classes.description: A custom awaitable class for socket operations that integrates with the async/await pattern, providing continuation support and exception handling.

methods.name: GetAwaiter
methods.description: Returns the object itself to be used as an awaiter for async operations.

methods.name: IsCompleted
methods.description: Indicates whether the asynchronous operation has completed.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Checks for socket errors and returns the number of bytes transferred, throwing an exception if an error occurred.

methods.name: OnCompleted
methods.description: Schedules the continuation to be run once the socket operation completes, possibly using the thread pool.

methods.name: UnsafeOnCompleted
methods.description: Same as 'OnCompleted', but suitable for low-level scenarios.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Triggers the execution of the continuation once the operation is finished.

methods.name: OnCompleted(SocketAsyncEventArgs _)
methods.description: Overrides the base method to handle completion of asynchronous socket operations, scheduling the continuation with a custom scheduler.
